review_description: After 2 of the 3 referred suppliers did not bother to get back to me after initial contact, so I contacted a few others from SQ web site. Ben from Solargain was very helpful and patient with me as a complete novice trying to understand all the facts and figures. He responded promptly to my queries, and made it all as simple as he could.  Installation proceeded ahead of schedule, and the installers were great. Have only had the system in for a bit over a week, but so far so good.

Ben was a fantastic consultant who is very knowledgeable about these products. I believe that he was able to get us the best possible product for our purpose. We were able to get the brand of inverter we wanted and Ben was able to upgrade the solar panels to a better product. Awesome customer service.  Installation was equally as good with the boys turning up on time and installed the system in no time. Explaining how to work the inverter as well.Extremely happy with the whole process.

Sales person knew what he was talking about. He even assisted me with a roof problem. Installation was effeciently completed within 10 days of signing the order. Best price for a 6.5 kW system with a Fronius inverter.
Helpful explained what was needed & efficient service, pleased with the installation.
Solargain provided varied options and were prepared to negotiate. They were helpful and the installers were friendly professional and knowledgeable. Very pleased with the result.
I recommend this company. The process was easy. Customer service was excellent. I paid for the system on a Monday & the next Thursday it was installed. Haven't paid for power since.

This is our second experience with Solargain. They did our original install and have recently performed and upgrade with more panels and battery. From the quote stage through to the install they have been a great company to deal with. we changed our minds a few times but they were very accommodating. I have recommended them to others and will continue to do so. Scott
We were reasonably pleased with the quote.  Their response time was good and  work carried out timely. The sales team were easy to contact and work with.

The onsite quote sold me. Ben came and checked the property and the local grid infrastructure (it's a rural property), and gave me some very helpful advice.The installation team was friendly, efficient and appear to have done a great job. The paperwork was all handled by the team and the grid connection was painless.Looking forward to the first power bill!

Solargain answered all our questions and were not pushy. They understood we already had a system and wanted to add to it. They could have sold a larger system as other companies tried but told use what we needed to hear.
Good sales experienceInstallation team punctual, speedy and tidyThey sent all the necessary info to EnergexI contacted my Electricity Supplier to arrange connection. They did not offer to
Got his name from the ikea package, although I did t do that one because I wanted a fronius.

Tesla Powerwall installation was nearly finished when the installers discovered a missing connector plug. Unfortunately it was proprietary to Tesla, they couldn't just get a universal connector.Whilst the part was despatched overnight I had to wait a week for the completion.Once up and running the battery is great. I only used 1 kWh from AGL in a week because the solar panels and the battery supply 99% of the house's energy needs.

Used Solargain to install our system. Was such an easy process with great levels of communication throughout the process. Install was quick after agreeing on a product. Installers were one time, neat and clean. Spent plenty of time explaining everything. Could not be happier

The information about our solar system was excellent, The installation crew were very good,  polite and a very neat job.customer service from the office staff are very nice to talk to. We are very happy and will recommend Solargain to anyone who asks.

We just had a solar panel array connected to an istore HWS fitted by Ben (Solargain Gold Coast) and his team. They were prompt and efficient and the whole installation was achieved weeks before competitor solar companies. It was so reassuring having all the systems organised and fitted by the one provider.Ben uses top quality products fitted by consummate professionals who all went above and beyond to make us happy. He even came in under the quoted price.I have no hesitation in recommending Ben Lister and his team at Solargain Gold Coast to anyone thinking about reducing their high energy costs.

The quotation team was informed and helpful, when I negotiated they were responsive and able to get pricing agreed quickly.  The system was installed one week later.The installation team was fantastic too.  They went beyond what they needed to do, explaining the system and the installation, even performing tasks that they were not scheduled to do.  Well done guys you were great representatives for your company.All round I was very impressed, I have already recommended SolarGain to two other people.

The process was handled well right from the beginning. From contacting Peter at SOlargain, to them sending through all the "to be expected's", paperwork and reminders on time and when they said they would.Installation day, the whole team arrived, friendly, fast, neat and system is working as expected

Your assistance was very much appreciated went with 315 kw jinko mono panels and Fronius inverter, yet to be installed on-a new build house. Was pleased with there approach and they are accredited which was a must be for me. Solar quotes information helped me to make I believe to be an informed decision.I would recommend anybody thinking of solar to use the list of panels and inverters from reputable companies which are well supported in Australia. I did not conifer any parts not on these lists.

Fantastic experience - came and explained everything clearly, measured and quoted multiple options, came back and reconfirmed when I went for a bigger system, and the installation was very professional - plus they came back and checked again the next day on the output.
Sales and quoting process was great. Installation guys were great.
Ben Lister and the installers all did a great job, very knowledgeable, helpful and punctual.
